title: Average of three scores
error_pattern: Integer division (int / int truncates before assignment to double)
description: Write a program that reads three integer scores and prints their average rounded to 2 decimal places. Example: 7 8 8 prints 7.67.

seeded_bug.root_cause: total and 3 are both int, so the division truncates before the result is stored in a double.

checkpoints.prediction_prompt: What value do you think total will have after this line runs?
What value do you think average will hold after the division on the previous line?

on_mismatch.step_1_meaningful_check: Divergence is meaningful only if actual_with_student_code != correct_value for this input (the code itself is wrong at this checkpoint).
on_mismatch.if_meaningful: classify against the 3-category taxonomy, then start Socratic Level 1 (Level 2 after 1 failed attempt, Level 3 after 2, direct-explanation fallback after 3 and log as hint-exhausted)
on_mismatch.if_not_meaningful: no intervention (prediction noise, e.g. mental-math slip on already-correct output)

checkpoint_policy.first_meaningful_divergence: Only the earliest meaningful divergence triggers intervention; later mismatches caused by it are logged as downstream effects, not separate errors.
